caption:
The head of Instagram named the three signals that decide reach across the app: watch time, likes per reach, sends per reach.

Adam Mosseri said it on 22 January 2025 and has restated it through 2026.

Notice that two of the three are ratios, not totals. Per reach. Not per post. You cannot fix them by posting more — only by making what you post land harder with the people it already reached.

And sends per reach is the one that gets you out of your own audience. Mosseri has called it the strongest signal for reaching people who do not follow you, because a send is one person handing you a personal recommendation to a specific stranger.

Here is the difference that matters when you sit down to write. Likes come from people who already like you. Sends come from people who think of someone else while they are watching.

Write for that second person. They are the one who buys the reach.

Source: Mosseri, 22 January 2025, naming watch time, likes per reach and sends per reach as the top three ranking signals; restated through 2026.
